provenance: measured (deterministic local guard execution against primary upstream PRs/Issues)

scenarios.title_zh: x402 `sui:mainnet` 赞助 PTB `GasData.owner` 绑定、Gas 代币与支付输入代币对象互斥防双花锁死（Equivocation Guard）与赞助 Gas 预算上限
scenarios.title_en: x402 sui:mainnet Sponsored PTB GasData.owner Binding, Coin Object Equivocation Guard & Gas Budget Cap
scenarios.question_zh: Sui 赞助交易中 `GasData.payment` 与 `SplitCoins` 支付输入复用了同一 Coin 对象 ID，引发链上对象锁死风险
scenarios.question_en: Sui sponsored PTB reuses the same Coin object ID in both GasData.payment and SplitCoins payment input
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统网关未校验 Sui `GasData.payment` 与业务输入 Coin 集合互斥，导致 Facilitator 赞助签名对象被锁死
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic gateway signs Sui PTB without checking disjointness between gas coins and payment input coins

scenarios.title_zh: x402 EVM `Permit2` `SignatureTransfer` Witness 类型后缀校验、批量 `permitted[]` 与 `transferDetails[]` 数组长度对齐及无序 Bitmap Nonce 防重放
scenarios.title_en: x402 EVM Permit2 SignatureTransfer Witness Type Suffix, Batch Array Length Parity & Unordered Nonce Replay Guard
scenarios.question_zh: 批量 `Permit2` 载荷中 `permitted[]` 长度与 `transferDetails[]` 长度不一致，企图越过单项额度校验
scenarios.question_en: Batch Permit2 payload has mismatched permitted[] and transferDetails[] array lengths
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统三层架构仅取首个 `permitted[0]` 校验，忽略批量 `transferDetails[]` 长度错位导致结算回滚
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic 3-Tier checks only index 0 and misses length mismatch across Permit2 batch transfer arrays

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Solana `spl-token-2022` `TransferFeeConfig` 扣费后净到账金额守恒（`net_received >= accept.amount`）与隐私转账扩展拦截
scenarios.title_en: x402 Solana SPL Token-2022 TransferFeeConfig Net-Received Conservation & Confidential Transfer Reject
scenarios.question_zh: 客户端按票面金额 `1,000,000` 发送带 `50 bps` 转账税的 Token-2022 资产，导致商户实际净到账 `995,000` 不足额
scenarios.question_en: Client sends exact gross amount on a 50 bps Token-2022 asset, leaving merchant underpaid after transfer fee deduction
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统验签器仅比对指令 `gross_amount` 而未扣除 Token-2022 链上 `TransferFeeConfig`，造成商户每笔短款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic verifier checks instruction gross amount without subtracting SPL Token-2022 transfer fee

scenarios.title_zh: x402 多 Facilitator 故障切换状态门禁（仅限 `502/503/504` 或超时切换，禁止在 `400/402` 确定性拒付时盲目重试）、过期 Nonce 驱逐与 v2 防降级
scenarios.title_en: x402 Multi-Facilitator Failover Gate (Blocking Failover on Deterministic 400/402 Reject), Nonce Eviction & v2 Floor
scenarios.question_zh: 主 Facilitator 因签名无效返回 `402` 确定性拒付后，路由层仍向备用 Facilitator 发起故障切换重试
scenarios.question_en: Router triggers secondary facilitator failover after primary facilitator deterministically rejects payload with HTTP 402
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统重试中间件对所有非 2xx 响应无差别轮询备用 Facilitator，放大无效签名风暴与双花窗口
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic retry middleware fails over to secondary facilitator on deterministic 400/402 verification failures

scenarios.title_zh: Google UCP BOPIS 门店自提库存锁有效期（`lock_expires_at`）、自提柜 PIN/车牌核验凭证绑定与缺货静默转付费快递拦截
scenarios.title_en: Google UCP BOPIS Store Inventory Lock TTL, Locker PIN/Curbside Token Binding & Unconsented Paid Shipping Fallback Block
scenarios.question_zh: BOPIS 门店自提部分商品缺货时，系统未经买方二次确认直接将缺货商品静默转为付费快递包裹
scenarios.question_en: Merchant silently converts out-of-stock BOPIS items to paid parcel shipping without buyer re-consent
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统 OMS 在门店缺货时自动拆单并加收快递运费，违背买方免运费门店自提授权
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic OMS auto-converts unavailable BOPIS store items into paid parcel shipping without buyer consent

scenarios.title_zh: Google UCP 展示币种与结算币种锁定、动态汇率报价有效期（`fx_quote_expires_at`）与银行家舍入（`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`）守恒
scenarios.title_en: Google UCP Settlement Currency Lock, FX Quote Expiry Gate & Bankers' Rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) Conservation
scenarios.question_zh: 结账中途汇率报价 `fx_quote_expires_at` 已过期，但客户端仍持旧汇率尝试调用 `complete_checkout`
scenarios.question_en: Agent attempts complete_checkout using an expired FX rate quote past fx_quote_expires_at
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统结账会话缓存初始汇率永不过期，被 Agent 择时套利或因浮点截断产生汇兑差额
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic checkout session caches initial FX rate indefinitely without enforcing fx_quote_expires_at

scenarios.title_zh: Google UCP 以旧换新（Trade-In）抵扣款托管冻结、质检后扣减上限（`<= provisional_credit`）与失窃设备 15 位 IMEI 黑名单核验
scenarios.title_en: Google UCP Trade-In Credit Provisional Escrow Hold, Post-Inspection Clawback Cap & Stolen 15-Digit IMEI Block
scenarios.question_zh: 买方提交的以旧换新手机 15 位 IMEI 命中失窃设备注册表，或将未质检预估抵扣款直接作为无条件即时折扣核销
scenarios.question_en: Buyer submits a trade-in device whose 15-digit IMEI appears on the lost/stolen device registry
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统促销引擎将以旧换新估值直接当作立减券扣减订单金额且不核验失窃 IMEI，导致空手套白狼欺诈
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic promo engine applies trade-in credit as an unconditional instant discount without stolen-IMEI check

scenarios.title_zh: OpenAI/Stripe ACP `Idempotency-Key` 规范化载荷指纹（JCS SHA-256）冲突检测（`409 Conflict`）、24 小时保留窗与并发在途锁（`425 Too Early`）
scenarios.title_en: OpenAI/Stripe ACP Idempotency-Key JCS SHA-256 Fingerprint Conflict (409), 24h Retention & In-Flight Lock (425)
scenarios.question_zh: Agent 在 24 小时保留窗内复用同一 `Idempotency-Key`，但篡改了请求体中的商品金额与收货地址指纹
scenarios.question_en: Agent reuses an existing Idempotency-Key within 24h while mutating the canonical JCS request payload fingerprint
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统幂等中间件仅按 Key 查缓存直接返回首次成功响应，掩盖了被篡改的新订单参数不一致
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic idempotency cache keys only on header string without verifying canonical payload SHA-256 match

scenarios.title_zh: OpenAI/Stripe ACP `SharedPaymentToken` 网络令牌密文（`TAVV`/`DTVV`）ECI 强认证门禁、低额 3DS 豁免上限与 23 位 ARN 退款溯源
scenarios.title_en: OpenAI/Stripe ACP SharedPaymentToken Network Cryptogram (TAVV/DTVV) ECI Gate, Low-Value 3DS Exemption Cap & 23-Digit ARN Refund Trace
scenarios.question_zh: 高额交易（`8,500` 分）谎称适用 `low_value` 小额豁免（上限 `3,000` 分）以跳过 3DS 强认证（`ECI=07`）
scenarios.question_en: High-value transaction (8,500 minor) claims low_value 3DS exemption (cap 3,000 minor) with unauthenticated ECI 07
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统支付网关盲信请求体传入的 `exemption_reason=low_value`，未校验法规豁免金额上限即放行无 3DS 扣款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic gateway honors caller-supplied low_value exemption flag without checking regulatory amount ceiling

scenarios.title_zh: Google AP2 授权令时钟偏移容差（`<=30s`）、闭环授权令最长有效期上限（`<=86400s`）与父子授权令时间窗包络继承（`child.exp <= parent.exp`）
scenarios.title_en: Google AP2 Mandate Clock-Skew Tolerance (<=30s), Closed Mandate TTL Cap (<=86400s) & Parent-Child Window Inheritance
scenarios.question_zh: 子 Agent 签发的子级 `CartMandate` 过期时间 `child.exp` 超出了父级 `IntentMandate` 的 `parent.exp` 边界
scenarios.question_en: Delegated sub-agent issues a child CartMandate whose expiration timestamp exceeds parent IntentMandate.exp
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统 JWT 验证器仅孤立检查子令牌自身 `exp > now`，忽略了其超出父级授权时间窗的权限展期逃逸
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic JWT validator checks only child.exp > now in isolation, allowing privilege lifetime extension beyond parent.exp

scenarios.title_zh: Google AP2 跨境 6 位 WCO 海关 HS 编码绑定、24 小时同一收件人免税额（`de_minimis`）拆单逃税聚合并归与 `DDP` 完税总价上限
scenarios.title_en: Google AP2 Cross-Border 6-Digit WCO HS Code Binding, 24h De-Minimis Split-Consignment Aggregation & DDP Ceiling
scenarios.question_zh: Agent 将 $900 订单拆分为 24 小时内同一收件人的两笔（$500 + $400）包裹以规避 $800 `de_minimis` 关税起征点且申报税额为 0
scenarios.question_en: Agent splits a $900 order into two shipments ($500 + $400) within 24h to the same consignee to evade the $800 de-minimis duty threshold
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统清关插件按单笔运单独立判断是否低于 $800 免税额，放任 24 小时内同一收件人拆单逃税导致海关扣货
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic customs plugin evaluates each shipment in isolation against de_minimis without 24h consignee aggregation

scenarios.title_zh: MCP `roots/list` 软链接真实路径（`realpath`）越界逃逸拦截、`sampling/createMessage` Token/停止词约束与 `notifications/cancelled` 孤儿进程清理
scenarios.title_en: MCP roots/list Realpath Symlink Escape Block, sampling/createMessage Bounds & notifications/cancelled Subprocess Cleanup
scenarios.question_zh: 工具通过工作区内的符号链接将访问路径解析到允许根目录 `/workspace/catalog` 之外的 `/etc/shadow`
scenarios.question_en: Tool resolves a workspace symlink to /etc/shadow outside the allowed MCP root /workspace/catalog
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统路径检查仅对词法路径前缀做字符串匹配，未调用 `realpath` 解析软链接导致任意宿主机文件读取
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic path filter checks lexical string prefix before resolving symlinks via realpath

scenarios.plane: Stripe Proration, Credit Note & Radar EFW Plane
scenarios.title_zh: Stripe 订阅变更折算策略门禁（`always_invoice` 需显式授权）、贷项通知单（`credit_notes`）累计上限与 Radar 早期欺诈预警（EFW）自动退款熔断
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Subscription Proration Gate, Cumulative Credit Note Paid Ceiling & Radar Early Fraud Warning (EFW) Refund Halt
scenarios.question_zh: 交易已触发 `radar.early_fraud_warning` 早期欺诈预警，客服 Agent 仍自动调用退款接口导致双倍资金损失（退款+拒付扣款）
scenarios.question_en: Support agent triggers automated refund on a charge with an active radar.early_fraud_warning, risking double loss
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统客服工单工作流未关联 `radar.early_fraud_warning` 状态即自动执行退款，导致商户承受退款与发卡行拒付双重扣款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic refund workflow ignores active Radar Early Fraud Warnings, causing double debit via refund plus chargeback

scenarios.plane: Visa TAP Proxy & BIN Routing Plane
scenarios.title_zh: Visa TAP 多跳代理 `Forwarded` 签名头一致性、`x-visa-tap-agent-model-id` 模型溯源白名单与支付令牌 BIN 前缀卡组路由校验
scenarios.title_en: Visa TAP Multi-Hop Proxy Forwarded Binding, Agent Model-ID Provenance Allowlist & Token BIN Network Routing Check
scenarios.question_zh: 以 `411111`（Visa BIN）开头的网络支付令牌被错误路由至 `mastercard` 清算通道
scenarios.question_en: Payment token with Visa BIN prefix 411111 is misrouted to the mastercard clearing rail
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统网关未校核支付令牌 BIN 号段与目标卡组清算通道映射，引发发卡行批量 ISO 8583 格式拒付
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic payment router dispatches token payload without validating BIN prefix against target card network rail

scenarios.plane: tau2-bench Airline Upgrade & PNR Split Plane
scenarios.title_zh: Sierra $\tau$-bench 2.0 航司舱位升级层级约束（拦截 `basic_economy` 违规升舱）、常旅客等级免费托运行李额计费与多人 PNR 拆单乘客集合守恒
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench Airline Cabin Upgrade Hierarchy (Blocking basic_economy Upgrade), Loyalty Baggage Fee & PNR Split Partition Conservation
scenarios.question_zh: Agent 违反航司舱位规则，对严格不可升舱的基础经济舱（`basic_economy`）客票直接调用升舱修改
scenarios.question_en: Agent attempts to upgrade a strictly non-upgradable basic_economy ticket to business class
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统工具调用未前置校验 `basic_economy` 舱位不可升级的领域铁律，导致违规改签与评测失分
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic tool execution modifies cabin class without enforcing basic_economy non-upgradability policy

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra $\tau$-bench 2.0 零售竞品价保核验（认证竞品域名白名单、同款现货且排除清仓/闪购价）与电信国际漫游包按天折算计费门禁
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench Retail Price-Match Policy Gate (Approved Competitor, Exact In-Stock SKU, Non-Liquidation) & Telecom Roaming Proration
scenarios.question_zh: 买方凭竞品平台的限时闪购清仓价（`is_liquidation_or_flash_sale=True`）申请零售差价退还
scenarios.question_en: Customer requests a retail price-match refund against a competitor's liquidation/flash-sale listing
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 传统客服 Agent 被提示词诱导直接按闪购清仓价退还差价，违反零售价保排除条款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic agent grants price-match refund on flash-sale or out-of-stock competitor listings
